data.body: Change 3534 patch set 1 merged as 599264d5669 at 04:52 PST 2026-11-23 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved; Gerrit rebased it onto 2a7342013fa). make verify before push: 21874 passed / 34 skipped default tier, 231 passed / 2 skipped integration tier. LLM-Review advisories, verified and fixed in a follow-up change (commit 1e470fb274e, worktree fu-f8d9-proxy-4xx) rather than a vote-resetting new patch set: (1) a proxy 408 or 429 answer to CONNECT is transient but was treated as a refusal; it now stays retryable. (2) A nested fallback group of refusals was missed; it is now judged recursively. (3) close_gate_remedy now also requires the CHANGE_SETTINGS class. (4) Docstring updated, and the degraded-verdict exit code is asserted exactly (2). 21 new tests and 406 existing tests on the changed paths pass. Ticket stays in_progress until the follow-up merges.
